description: Compare a GitHub PR's check runs against its base commit and classify every check: introduced (passing on base, failing on head), pre-existing (failing on both), external (deploy or hosted surface, or waiting on maintainer approval), fixed, passing, indeterminate (no usable base evidence), or pending. Answers the question every red PR actually asks: which of these failures are mine?
